Sun of a Beach by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Set in the peaceful Old Florida Cottages neighborhood, Sun of a Beach offers a relaxing retreat just 200 steps from beach access—no busy streets to cross. The updated home sleeps up to 10 guests comfortably. On the first floor, the primary suite features a king bed, walk-in shower, and double vanity, while the guest room with a queen bed has its own full bath. Both rooms have private balconies and Amazon TVs for relaxing. Upstairs, the second floor shines with an open living and dining area, plus a gourmet kitchen. A cozy bunk room with twin-over-queen beds makes for a fun hangout spot. The best part?

The huge wraparound balcony with breathtaking gulf views. Perfect for catching the sunset or simply unwinding after a day at the beach. With a heated community pool, bikes, and plenty of nearby spots to eat and shop, Sun of a Beach has everything you need for a fantastic getaway! Our dedicated team at Oversee 30A, a local company, is committed to ensuring your stay is nothing short of exceptional. We strive for perfection and are just a stone's throw away should you require any assistance. Reach out to us anytime, seven days a week, with the added peace of a 24/7 emergency line.
